title: the cast door refuses a writes_to outside bounds.in
intention: transitions._shape_lacks refuses a ticket whose decisions or outcomes write to a path its bounds.in does not hold, and lets bounds.in hold more than those writes.
why: Measured 2026-11-16 over 480 bounded tickets: 20 write outside bounds.in (18 PROVED, plus 96c1c2ea5ce9 and f695fac922cd, whose paths entered at rehearse --decide), and the cast door checked only that bounds is two lists. 7 hold a bounds.in path that no writes_to names; all are tester red tickets that put the red proof in bounds.in to dedup while D1 writes [] (cairn/devices/tester/red_tickets.py). Orchestrator 2026-11-16: 'Either add it to the cast-door ticket set, or record why the rule allows the gap. Don't leave it as a side note.'
traces_to: Law 4: a rule that matters is enforced by physics; the bounds rule was SKILL.md prose.
how: Once bounds is well-shaped, every decisions[i].writes_to and outcomes[i].writes_to path not in bounds.in is a lack naming the path. A comment records why containment runs one way only. SKILL.md:204 now says in 'holds every writes_to'. The sail judge_plan proof fixture's bounds take its own writes.

clauses.claim: in cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_cast_refuses_a_plan_that_is_prose.py, a_write_outside_bounds_in_is_refused: a decision and an outcome writing a path bounds.in lacks are each refused naming the path, with nothing landed, and a bounds.in wider than the writes casts. Red on origin/main (both cast), and teeth 1-5 stay green

decisions.text: D1: _shape_lacks refuses a writes_to outside bounds.in, with the one-way containment's why in a comment.
D3: SKILL.md:204 reworded to 'holds every writes_to'; the judge_plan proof fixture's bounds.in takes its own writes.

measured.saw: 20 of 480 bounded tickets write outside bounds.in, and 7 hold extra bounds.in paths, all tester reds
measured.how: set compare of bounds.in against the union of decisions and outcomes writes_to over CairnCommons/tickets/*.json

measured.saw: tooth 6 red on the base and green on the fix; 19 casting or judging proofs green after the sail fixture's bounds took its writes
measured.how: PYTHONPATH=. python3 on each proof that greps cast_ticket, _shape_lacks or judge_plan
